answer: A challenger who proves duplication seizes the stake; a false challenge burns the challenger's own deposit. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must lock a ferrous-token stake sized to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious duplicate identities during a violet-flagged audit round. Because forging many identities multiplies locked capital and audit exposure, the nebula of fake participants becomes economically irrational, keeping one identity per operator cheaper than a swarm. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
